items.title: Here is the dinosaur that smells the best
items.summary: An Australian dinosaur steps past the T-rex itself. New findings suggest that muttaburrasaurus had the best sense of smell of all. - It has a small lump on its nose that is really prominent, says Professor Vera Weisbecker.
items.title_original: Här är dinosaurien som luktar bäst
items.summary_original: En australisk dinosaurie kliver förbi självaste T-rex. Nya fynd tyder på att muttaburrasaurus hade bäst luktsinne av alla. – Den har en liten klump på nosen som verkligen är framträdande, säger professor Vera Weisbecker.

items.title: The boss – healthier but more stressed than co-workers
items.summary: Managers are generally physically healthier than their employees. However, more stressed and mentally burdened. A special group is also particularly vulnerable.
items.title_original: Chefen – friskare men mer stressad än medarbetare
items.summary_original: Chefer är generellt sett fysiskt friskare än sina medarbetare. Däremot mera stressade och mentalt belastade. En särskild grupp är dessutom extra utsatt.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Relief fills the Russian war coffers
items.summary: Lifting sanctions against Russia is unrealistic, believes Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. A boost in oil revenues goes to the Kremlin's dwindling war coffers.
items.summary_original: Att lyfta på sanktioner mot Ryssland är verklighetsfrånvänt, anser Ukrainas president Volodymyr Zelenskyj. En skjuts i oljeintäkterna går till Kremls sinande krigskassa.

items.title: Government proposes bills to strengthen efforts for accountability for Russia’s aggression against Ukraine
items.summary: Today, the Government is taking an important step to ensure accountability for Russia’s aggression against Ukraine. Through two Government Bills, it is proposed that Sweden join the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine and accede to the Convention establishing an International Claims Commission for Ukraine. Sweden has played an active role in the establishment of both mechanisms.
